text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion has possessed immense talent from the get-go, but this summer camp has proved to be an immense boon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Umm… Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for running with me. ♪ I had a lot of fun thanks to your help.

text_block_list.name: Older Student
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… You're kidding me… How are you not even out of breath?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She can now easily go head-to-head with older students. Her growth is beyond what I could have imagined.
choice_data_list: (And she's got the potential to get even better!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm? Are you okay, Trainer? Your eyes are flashing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …! That voice…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Dammit! I'm not improving!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, this isn't it. Then I'll try the next one…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …No.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I like the way Shakur looks when she's deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Though, most of the time, she notices me looking at her right away and gets irritated!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Shall we get back to training? I have to work hard too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is! Lady Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And who might you be?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I'm just your average reporter! Your accomplishments have made you the talk of the town! You're the favorite to win the Shuka Sho by a long shot!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm honored to hear it. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, hehe. Not only are you strong and beautiful, but just watching you run is enough to lift my spirits!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: You're truly amazing! Would it be okay if I got a picture?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: My apologies, but interview requests must be made through the academy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Whoops! Is this your security? The two of you together would make a great photo! Do you mind?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's not fair! You got a head start! I want a picture too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: I'm from a local TV station! Would you be interested in doing a live interview?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My, this is rather chaotic… I really might be the favorite!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A crowd of onlookers is gathering quick. For Fine Motion's sake, as well as all the other Umamusume at camp, I'd like to request all of them to leave…
choice_data_list: I'm going to be straight with them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's come to this…

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Understood. Your Highness, please accompany your trainer inside.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's meet in an official setting next time, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ah! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: When you suddenly mentioned "force," I thought you might fight them off for a second.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I acted rashly, there's a good chance I would have gotten us into even bigger trouble. Leaving things to the professionals was the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: On the contrary, I thought very highly of your judgment.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I have confidence in people who can maintain their composure. I'd say you've charmed me all over again. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm going to miss my chance! Lady Fine, I'd like a photo too!

text_block_list.name: Onlookers
text_block_list.text: There sure are a lot of people over there. You think it's some kind of celebrity?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I'm thinking up a plan, things become even more boisterous than before. Without thinking, I shout…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Now's our chance, Your Highness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell the crowd of reporters that this summer camp is a vital time for Fine Motion and that she can't take any interviews right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I promise to provide an opportunity for them to interview her after camp is over and ask them all to leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It takes a good half hour or so, but with the assistance of Fine Motion's security team, we clear everyone out.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You surprised me, shouting like that all of a sudden. Did you have some kind of secret plan?
choice_data_list: I thought they'd understand if we talked it out.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see. You place rather high faith in people, then?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: That was very honorable of you, but please leave everything to us in these types of situations. That is precisely what we're here for.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: However, the way Trainer handled things must have left a good impression on the reporters. I think they'll be easier to deal with in the future.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And more than anything, you were pretty cool! Great job!
